response.overview: The documentary “Habilidad” tells the story of the Murillo family in Colombia from the perspective of the youngest sister, Carito. Now retired, Carito grew up with 14 siblings, five of whom were born deaf. Due to a congenital condition, all five lost their sight at the age of 30. Three have since passed away, leaving Carina and Ligia, two women aged 81 and 82. They are both deafblind and have developed unique ways to communicate and engage with the world.  The film offers an intimate glimpse into their daily lives and their unique methods of communication, marked by love, resilience, and the unbreakable bond of the Murillo family. “Habilidad” is a tribute to the human capacity to maintain dignity and joy in life, as well as a celebration of female strength.
response.title: Habilidad
